narrative.overview:
The docs are a dilution refrigerator seen in section. The whole frame is the deep navy vacuum can; the sidebar navigation is the stack of lab-blue stages, read top to bottom from the setup plate down to the API reference; the page itself is a light window inset into the can. A reader always knows which stage they are on because that plate fills with the accent.

The system is a restyle of Furo, not a replacement: every color lands through Furo's own custom properties, layered on a small set of `--qt-*` primitives on `body`. Density is that of a reference manual: a 72ch reading column, generous section breaks, code blocks that look like terminal output on the can's own color. Decoration is structural only: the accent bar on h2 and the accent edge on class signatures, which describe the cryostat rather than ornament the page.

It replaces the stock white-sidebar, purple-accent Python docs look.
keyCharacteristics: Dark navy can frame around a single rounded light reading window.
Navigation as stage plates with 6px outer corners (caption 6px 6px 0 0, list 0 0 6px 6px); each plate caption is a link.
Current stage plate fills solid with the accent.
The instrument catalogue is a grid of tinted, 8px-rounded panels.
One accent family (Lab blue: accent for fills and edges, link blue for text links).
Archivo for all prose and headings, JetBrains Mono for code, both self-hosted.

rules.name: The Plating Rule
rules.body: The accent is the plating of the cryostat: it appears as the current-stage fill, as edges (the h2 bar, the class signature top border), and as focus. It is never a background for a resting surface on the reading window.

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: The palette has one hue family, blue. The accent (#4fa3d1) is for fills, edges and focus; link blue (#1b6290 light, #7fc0e6 dark) is for text. A second accent hue is not part of this system.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Caption Rule
rules.body: Stage captions override Furo's uppercase: sentence case, letter-spacing 0. Small-caps-style uppercase labels are not part of this system.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for code and measured values (version numbers in the select). Prose never goes mono.

rules.name: The Flat Can Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. If a surface must stand out, change its tone or give it an accent edge.

rules.name: The Accent Edge Rule
rules.body: Structural markers are accent lines: the 2.5rem x 3px bar above each h2 and the 3px top border on API class signatures. Sidebar plates carry no top edge.

dos: **Do** route every color through Furo's custom properties backed by the `--qt-*` primitives, and define both light and dark values.
**Do** keep the 3px accent top border on class signatures and the 2.5rem x 3px accent bar above every article h2.
**Do** keep plates at 6px outer corners (caption 6px 6px 0 0, list 0 0 6px 6px) and the reading window as the only large rounded surface (rounded.window); catalogue panels stay at rounded.panel.
**Do** mark the current stage by filling its plate with the accent and switching its text to Can Navy.
**Do** keep stage captions in sentence case, and keep them as links.
**Do** use JetBrains Mono only for code and measured values; Archivo for everything else; self-host both.
**Do** keep code blocks dark on the can's own color in both themes.
donts: **Don't** add box-shadows; depth comes from tone (The Flat Can Rule).
**Don't** introduce a second accent hue beyond the blue family.
**Don't** fill resting surfaces on the reading window with the accent; accent is edge, focus and current state only.
**Don't** add uppercase tracked labels or kickers above headings.
